0022600217.text: The Washington Wizards, at 4-6 and 2-4 on the road, are on a three-game losing streak and sit 9th in the East and 3rd in the Southeast, 2.5 games back, as they visit the Indiana Pacers for their 12th game of the season. Indiana is 3-7 overall, 0-5 at home, has lost its last game, and sits 11th in the East and 3rd in the Central, 3.5 games back. Washington is missing Bilal Coulibaly (hand), Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and the 2026-27 season series has no games yet, after the Wizards won the 2025-26 series 3-1 and beat the Pacers 131-118 in Washington on February 20, 2026.
